summary: Recent enhancements to the OpenGL implementation in Firefox have focused on performance improvements for graphics rendering. Specifically, the integration of `glMapBufferRange` on Metal ANGLE — which accelerates canvas rendering by optimizing how data is accessed in graphics memory — enables smoother visual experiences in web applications. This change is crucial as it allows developers to create more responsive and graphically intensive web content, benefiting users with improved performance during graphic-heavy tasks, while the careful handling of data offsets ensures that graphics data is processed accurately and efficiently. **This means that users can expect better performance and responsiveness in web applications that rely on complex graphics.**
